The strains fed on glycerol as a carbon source to produce isoprene when containing the plasmid of the ara- BAD promoter; strains without this plasmid were fed with glucose. Meanwhile, suitable antibiotics were added to the culture broth with the following concentrations: ampicillin (100 ug/ml), kanamycin (50 pg/ml), and chloramphenicol (34 pg/ml). Plasmid construction To improve the expression level of heterologous genes in E. col, the nucleotide sequences of terminal olefinforming fatty acid decarboxylase (OleT) gene (GenBank No. HQ709266.1) from Jeotgalicoccus sp. ATCC 8456 and the oleate hydratase (OhyAM) gene (GenBank No. ACT54545.1) from Elizabethkingia meningoseplica were firstly evaluated assisted by online software (http:// www.genscript.com/cgi-bin/tools/rare_codon_analysis) and then they were optimized according to the preterred codon usage of E. coli (http://www.jcat.de/). The optimized olelje and ohyAEM gene were chemically synthesized by Genray Company using plasmid pGH as the vector (called pGHoleT and pGH-okyAEM, respectively). The oleT: gene fragment was obtained by digestion of pGH-olel, with BamHl and Sacl and was then ligated into the corresponding sites of pCOLADuet-1 to create pYJM30. Using the primers oleT-F (5'-CTAGCTAGCGGCAAC ACTTAAG AGGGATAAG-3') and oleT-R (5'-CTAGG AGCTCTTATGTTCTGTCT ACAAC-3') with plasmid PGH-olel as a template, the olel gene containing Nhel and Sacl sites was obtained by PCR. The isolated oleT gene fragment was digested using Nhel and Sacl and inserted into the Nhel/Sacl sites of pBAD18 to yield plasmid pYJM31. To construct the plasmid YIM32, the ohyAEM gene was amplified by PCR using the primers ohya-F (5'-CG CGGATCCGAACCCGATCACCTCTAAATICG-3) and ohya-R (5'-CCCAAGCTTTTAACCACGGATACCTTTA) ACCCA-3') with the plasmid pGH-ohyAEM as a template. The isolated ohyAEM gene fragment was excised with BamHI and HindIll and was inserted into the vector pCOLADuet-1 to form PYIM32. The ohyArM gene fragment was obtained by excision from pGH-ohyAe with Bglll and Xhol and was introduced into pYJM30 to make pYJM33. The olel-ohyAEM gene was digested from pYJM33 with BamHI and Xhol and ligated into pEI-28a(+) to creale pYJM34. Using the primers ohya-F1(5-ACGCGTCG ACGAACCCGATCACCTCTAAATTCG-3') and ohya-R, the oiyAEM-1 fragment was amplified by PCR with plasmid PGH-ohyAEM as a template. The amplified ohyAEM-1 gene was cut by Sall and HindIll and then introluced into the plasmid pYJM31 to create pYJM35.
